subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 12, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has been further refined with the introduction of relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, building on the recent improvement of per-pipeline staging directories to avoid publish races between concurrent builds. This change ensures that the latest ISO images resolve correctly on the host web root, and you can read more about the details of this improvement on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Development 
The development team continues to work on refining the ISO build pipeline, with recent commits focusing on improving the stability and reliability of the release process. As an Arch-based distribution, AcreetionOS benefits from the robust package management of pacman and the extensive Arch repositories, allowing us to provide a wide range of software packages to our users. For more information on our development process, you can visit our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community 
The community has been actively discussing the latest software releases, including the recent update to Emacs 31.1, which brings a long list of changes and improvements to the popular editor. Additionally, our users have been keeping up to date with the latest security updates, including those issued by AlmaLinux and the stable kernel set released on Sunday. For more information on these updates, you can visit our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html or check out our flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html for the latest news and updates.
